name: Learning to Ride
summary: Randal Hunter offers to teach you horseback riding once you have enough coin. Train with him, and Katie will provide a free mount.

sections.title: Randal's Offer
sections.body: Randal Hunter can teach you to ride a horse for a fee. Once you have enough coin, speak with him to learn Apprentice Riding. Katie will provide a free mount after your training, and you can purchase additional mounts.

faq.q: Who teaches me to ride a horse?
faq.answer: Randal Hunter offers to teach you horseback riding for a fee.

faq.q: What do I need to learn riding?
faq.answer: You need enough coin to pay Randal Hunter for training.

faq.q: Who gives me a free mount?
faq.answer: Katie provides a free mount after you train with Randal Hunter.
After training, you can purchase additional mounts.

faq.q: Do other creatures need different riding skills?
faq.answer: Different creatures require their own riding skill, and you will need to find trainers for each.
